# Dragoon's Town v0.22

This update improves background handling and Android save reliability. Existing progress and economy values are preserved.

- Even a short background absence now earns capped offline income instead of counting as active play. Managers do not spend during the absence. Overlapping browser/Android callbacks cannot credit it twice or bypass the offline cap.
- Before opening an Android update or minimizing with Back, pause gameplay and finish writing the current validated save. Failed or stale saves keep the app open, explain the problem and allow retry.
- Keep both district Buy 1 and MAX buttons visible in short landscape layouts, including large text and Android screen insets. Closing district details returns keyboard focus to the location.
- Correct the game version shown in save status and reports, and prevent mismatched browser/Android versions during packaging.
- Add broader, reproducible strategy/legacy-save simulations and real mobile touch checks to development verification. No income, price, milestone or prestige values are changed blindly.

No real payments, advertisements, account service or paid servers were added. Android code 11 retains the original package and signing identity. Update through More → App updates → Check now without uninstalling.

Physical Thor/Android 13 installation and sustained performance remain a separate playtest; automated browser checks and compilation are not device test results.

AI-assisted development with OpenAI Codex.
